findings.finding: tests/test_anonymisation_host_runbook.py took the first '-m MODULE' of a line, so a line prefixed by python -m runner.host_env ... -- would have been read as the launcher, not in PARSERS, and dropped silently.
The runbook's steps 12 and 13 had lost their line continuation ('converse       --receipt'); the lines ran in bash but read as a formatting error.

Of the runbook's host commands, runner.offline_bundle verify reads production mode, diagnostic level, the preset or backend and AWS_REGION; harness.commands.converse_smoke prepare and assess need AWS_REGION and a Converse configuration (build_converse_judge refuses another backend), and AN1c needs production mode; converse_smoke check and tools.anonymisation_host_smoke read none (Region and models are flags). Neither .env nor .env.harness sets ORCHESTRATOR_PRODUCTION_MODE, and .env.harness is not among the bundle roots.
findings.basis: code read 2026-10-27; deploy/offline_bundle.json roots; key names of .env and .env.harness.

findings.finding: No transport test asserted a Converse Region literal before R9e. The only us-east-1 literals in tests were two mantle endpoint-override pairs (an explicit URL echoed back) in tests/test_transport_config.py and tests/test_transport_presets.py.

decisions.question: Preset definition and default model (point 1)
decisions.answer: (a) BEDROCK_CONVERSE_EU has default_model None; the model comes only from ORCHESTRATOR_TRANSPORT_MODEL. backend bedrock_converse, default_region eu-north-1, no endpoint, no API key, capabilities CAPABILITIES_REGISTRY['bedrock_converse'], production_suitable True; notes cite OD1-r1, OD7-global, R8-D2, R8-D3.
decisions.reason: Operator's '1a'. The model is the secret's (R8-D2) and will change (OD7 target Opus 5); a preset default would go stale silently. Without a model build_converse_backend refuses.
decisions.consequence: tests/test_transport_presets.py TestBedrockConverseEuPreset.

decisions.question: The secret-name test (point 2)
decisions.answer: (a) tests/test_aws_env_config_template.py: test_the_stored_preset_exists_and_is_production_suitable (the name resolved from the template is in PRESET_REGISTRY, production-suitable, backend in PRODUCTION_BACKENDS) and test_the_launcher_accepts_the_templates_value (runner.host_env.validate accepts the resolved value for the parameter file's Region); test_preset_name_is_the_lasting_r9e_rule no longer checks for BEDROCK_CONVERSE_US.
decisions.consequence: The launcher's acceptance of the real secret is tested from the template itself.

decisions.question: What 'no transport test fixes the region' covers (point 4)
decisions.answer: (a) No test asserts that a Converse Region, or the Region the production path uses, is a literal; tests read Regions from a preset's attribute, the deployment parameters, or sentinels. The two mantle endpoint-override tests use SENTINEL_MANTLE_URL (Region zz-sentinel-1). Assertions about the mantle presets' own eu-west-1 values stay (they test a preset's attribute, not the transport's Region). TestBedrockConverseEuPreset::test_definition states the preset's eu-north-1, which is the ticket's definition of the preset.
decisions.consequence: tests/test_transport_config.py TestBedrockConfig::test_bedrock_with_explicit_endpoint and tests/test_transport_presets.py TestEnvOverrides::test_endpoint_override amended.
